affected.note: Customers and delivery recipients of the Morinaga Direct Store (formerly Tenshi no Kenko) mail-order business who ordered between 2018-05-01 and 2022-03-13. Email addresses were included for 3,887 people. The company found no trace of exfiltration but could not rule it out.

summary.en: Confectionery maker Morinaga found on 2022-03-13 that multiple servers had been compromised by a third party, likely through a network device vulnerability. Personal data of 1,648,922 customers of its mail-order store may have been leaked.
summary.ja: 森永製菓は、2022年3月13日深夜に複数のサーバが第三者による不正アクセスを受けたことを確認した。ネットワーク機器の脆弱性を突かれた可能性が高く、通販事業「森永ダイレクトストア」の顧客164万8,922人の個人情報が流出した可能性がある。
